title: Governance request orchestration for granular log redaction and export scenarios
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Create an orchestration and decision framework that intake, scores, and routes customer requests for log redaction, retention adjustments, PII handling, and audit exports. The goal is to reduce time-to-response for enterprise customers while ensuring every request follows the right legal/compliance path, required tech work, and SLOs. Deliverables: (1) triage scoring rubric and routing rules, (2) templated response flows for Support/CS/SEs, (3) engineering runbook stubs for implementation (API + console), and (4) intake automation design (Slack/Forms -> Linear -> gated escalations). Emphasis on minimizing manual review where safe (policy templates + automated redaction checks) while preserving legal hold and export fidelity when required.
comments: 2025-02-13 — Kickoff: cross-functional sync with Legal, Security, Support and Platform. Agreed scope excludes ad-hoc forensic exports requiring legal sign-off.

2025-02-20 — Draft triage rubric proposed: score by sensitivity (PII tiers), retention delta requested, customer tier (enterprise vs self-serve), and urgency (legal hold presence). Action: PM to add scoring weights; Security to validate PII tier definitions.

2025-02-26 — Engineering feedback (ENG-8412): recommend two routing outcomes: (A) safe-automation path for non-PII redaction + retention <=90d, (B) manual-review path for PII/long-retention/export-with-legal. Also proposed an API contract for 'GovernanceRequest' object. Action: schedule API design session.

2025-03-01 — Legal review notes: need canonical checklist for export release (identity verification, purpose, data minimization). Suggested adding an 'export purpose' enum and retention justification field to intake form.

2025-03-03 — Design review (Maria Gonzalez): mockups for Console intake panel and templated response generator. UX asks for visibility into routing reason and estimated SLA. Action: include an 'Escalation Rationale' field in the ticket payload.

2025-03-05 — PM decision: proceed with 2-phase delivery. Phase 1 (April): triage rubric, templated responses, intake form, and minimal Automation Q1. Phase 2 (May-June): Console routing UI, API contract, and start of automated redaction checks. Open questions: retention enforcement strategy (platform vs customer policy enforcement) and KMS/HSM gating for exported artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: A triage scoring rubric published and reviewed by Security and Legal
Support/CS have a set of templated responses and handoff checklist for manual reviews
Intake form created (internal Slack form + Console) that captures required fields: customer id, request type, retention change, PII tier, legal hold flag, export purpose
Routing rules documented (automation vs manual) with expected SLOs: 48h for automated-safepath, 5 business days for manual review
Implementation plan with API contract sketch and engineering tickets created (ENG backlog)
Security sign-off for any automated redaction checks and export handling
risks: Automated redaction may produce false negatives for complex PII patterns, leading to compliance risk
Legal hold workflows may conflict with retention adjustments if not correctly sequenced
Large export payloads may trigger performance and cost spikes if run ad-hoc
Customers may request retention adjustments that require data restoration or reprocessing not supported by current storage architecture
next_steps: Finalize triage weightings with Security and Legal by 2025-03-12
Create Linear sub-issues for Phase 1 implementation (intake form, templates, routing rules)
Schedule API design workshop with Engineering (ENG-8412) week of 2025-03-17
Prototype Console intake panel mock in Figma and review with Design on 2025-03-10
Confirm monitoring/dashboard metrics for request volume, routing accuracy, and SLO adherence
